critique:
**Strength:** The seamless integration of physics-driven, neon particle swarms orbiting unseen attractors over complex, shifting moiré gradient overlays creates a deeply textured and mesmerizing cyber-cosmic atmosphere. 

**Area for improvement:** Relying on overly familiar synthwave tropes—like the horizontally sliced neon sun and the perspective wireframe grid—dilutes the visual novelty of the piece, while the arbitrary insertion of the guinea pig image awkwardly fractures the immersion.
